A1.justification: Both PDFs describe QiMeng-CodeV-R1 and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. The appendices can be matched despite the checklist inserted in v5; no material gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original model evaluations, training ablations, timing measurements, testbench experiments, and appendix analyses, including the MAGE integration experiment.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results in Section 3 and the appendices, including benchmark scores and testbench measurements.

M1.justification: The automated testbench, round-trip synthesis, distillation, adaptive DAPO, and reward remain unchanged. The corrected filtering overview agrees with the detailed procedure already stated in v3 Section 2.3.1; it does not establish an actual algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same GitHub-derived training data, VerilogEval v1/v2 and RTLLM v1.1/v2 coverage, testbench scenarios, and Appendix C.4 MAGE integration experiment. The checklist adds no evaluated dataset or task.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–2 and the appendix comparisons. The baseline DAPO timing comparison and DeepSeek-V3-generated testbench comparison are also retained without added or removed comparators.

E3.justification: The Section 2 overview corrects the reported RL filtering threshold from removing examples solved in any of five attempts to all five. This corrects a stated selection setting, although Section 2.3.1 already specified all five in v3. No rerun or other protocol revision is documented.

E4.justification: The equivalence-checking and difficulty ablations, test-time scaling, acceleration analysis, and testbench tests are unchanged. Appendices C–D retain the same distribution analyses, error breakdowns, agent experiment, and case studies.

E5.justification: New checklist item 7 explicitly acknowledges the absence of error bars, confidence intervals, and significance tests, explaining that repeated runs for statistical analysis were considered prohibitively expensive. This adds replication-related disclosure, without adding uncertainty estimates or documenting increased runs.

E6.justification: All matched numerical results and qualitative findings are retained. For example, CodeV-R1-7B still reports 72.9% pass@1 on RTLLM v1.1 in Table 1, and 68.8% on VerilogEval v2-SR and 68.0% on RTLLM v2 in Table 2. Appendix result entries also match.

T1.justification: Definition 2.1, Theorem 2.1, the Appendix A.1 proof and explanations, and the loss and penalty equations are unchanged. Correcting instruction-variable primes in Section 2 does not alter the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The conclusion newly claims, to the authors' knowledge, the first Verilog-domain LLM demonstrating strong reasoning with consistent test-time scaling. The abstract, introduction, principal framework contributions, and performance claims otherwise retain their meaning.

C2.justification: Appendix C.3 corrects the truncation explanation to 16384 tokens minus prompt length, replacing minus original response length. The checklist also newly explains the statistical-analysis limitation through RL training cost. The existing Appendix G limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Checklist item 5 specifies Hugging Face for the model and dataset and GitHub for code; v3 already announced release and supplied the project-page link. This adds access information without establishing a new release. Hyperparameters, hardware, training times, and prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The added first-in-domain test-time-scaling claim strengthens novelty positioning in the conclusion. Section 4 and the research bibliography remain unchanged, with no additional cited work supporting this positioning.

P1.justification: v5 inserts a NeurIPS checklist before Appendix A, expands acknowledgements, lightly revises the conclusion, and corrects several phrases and variable references. The scientific narrative and ordering of existing sections and appendices remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: The checklist adds numbered-list layouts, while expanded acknowledgements alter reference spacing and corrected paragraphs undergo localized reflow. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–10, and Algorithm 1 retain their displays; shifted appendix pagination does not represent new visual evidence.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves clarity by resolving the contradictory filtering overview and correcting Appendix C.3's truncation explanation. Explicit disclosure of missing statistical analysis improves transparency. The experiments and proofs remain unchanged, and the stronger priority claim receives no additional supporting comparison, so the overall gain is limited.
